docket_entries.description: MONEY CLAIM OF PLAINTIFF FOR $472.00 FILED BY BERMAN, NAOMI AS TO DEFENDANT LOW, CANDACE ORDER SETTING TRIAL ISSUED FOR SEP-14-2018 AT 01:30 PM IN DEPT 506
PROOF OF SERVICE FILED ON CLAIM OF PLAINTIFF - FEE FOR SERVICE $ 0.00 - SERVED AUG-05-2018, PERSONAL SERVICE AS TO DEFENDANT LOW, CANDACE

SMALL CLAIMS CALENDAR OF SEP-14-2018 - TAKEN UNDER SUBMISSION AS OF SEP-14-2018 BY CHRISTINE VAN AKEN. 506 PLAINTIFF NAOMI BERMAN IS PRESENT. DEFENDANT CANDACE LOW IS PRESENT. PLAINTIFF EXHIBITS RETAINED. JUDGE: CHRISTINE VAN AKEN; CLERK: G. FELICIANO; NOT REPORTED. 506
SMALL CLAIMS HEARING OF SEP-14-2018 - JUDGMENT.

THE COURT HAS ORDERED THE FOLLOWING JUDGMENT ENTERED: IT IS ADJUDGED THAT PLAINTIFF BERMAN, NAOMI RECOVER FROM DEFENDANT LOW, CANDACE $472.00 PRINCIPAL, $30.00 COSTS, TOTAL JUDGMENT $502.00, DEFENDANT SHALL PAY PLAINTIFF'S UNREIMBURSED VET BILLS ($472) AND COSTS. CIVIL CODE 3342(A) MAKES DEFENDANT STRICTLY LIABLE FOR DOG BITES REGARDLESS OF OTHER FACTORS. THE DAMAGES CLAIMED ARE REASONABLE BECAUSE THEY ARE WHAT PLAINTIFF'S VET ACTUALLY CHARGED AND PLAINTIFF WAS NOT RQUIRED TO SECOND-GUESS HER VET'S RECOMMENDATION TO X-RAY THE INJURY. STAY OF EXECUTION 30 DAYS PLAINTIFF'S EXHIBITS RECEIVED
ACKNOWLEDGMENT OF SATISFACTION OF JUDGMENT, FULLY SATISFIED, AS TO DEFENDANT LOW, CANDACE
EXHIBITS FROM EXHIBIT REPORT DATED DEC-03-2018 ORDERED DESTROYED
